note: Set A gives the single quantitative claim on the page correctly: approximately 100 issues and concerns from the initial LCIT reviews of the Draft Final Reports across the four mission concepts, with a supporting quote. Set B's first claim is equally correct, but its other two claims restate the same 100 figure misbound — one to 'Draft Final Reports | number of findings' and one to 'mission concepts | quantity | 100' (the concepts number four, not 100) — with spliced, non-verbatim quotes. Neither set captures the later bullets (STDT modifications, feedback, reduction of remaining issues), so both are incomplete, but B adds wrong claims rather than useful ones.
remarks: Both sets omit the page's other facts: STDTs made significant modifications to Final Reports before public release, provided per-finding feedback and change references, and the final set of remaining issues/concerns was significantly reduced. Set B's claims 2 and 3 are essentially the same 100-count fact re-extracted under wrong entities/attributes, and their quotes are spliced fragments rather than contiguous text.
